#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""从 split-preview JSON 导出思维导图（Mermaid mindmap，Obsidian 原生渲染）。

只读消费 outputs/split-preview-<board>.json，唯一写入 = outputs/思维导图-<board>.md。
不触碰 原白板/、节点/、检验白板/。
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def sanitize(label: str) -> str:
    # Mermaid mindmap 节点文本不能含引起解析歧义的括号/引号，统一收敛
    label = re.sub(r"[()\[\]{}\"`]", " ", label)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", label).strip()


def build_tree(candidates):
    tree = {}
    for c in candidates:
        path = c["source_anchor"]["heading_path"]
        node = tree
        for part in path:
            node = node.setdefault(part, {"__children__": {}, "__cands__": []})["__children__"] if False else node.setdefault(part, {})
        node.setdefault("__cands__", []).append(c)
    return tree


def render(node: dict, indent: int, lines: list):
    for key, child in node.items():
        if key == "__cands__":
            continue
        lines.append("  " * indent + sanitize(key))
        render(child, indent + 1, lines)
        for c in child.get("__cands__", []):
            mark = ""
            if c.get("name_conflict"):
                mark += " ⚠重名"
            if c.get("derived_overlap", {}).get("overlapping"):
                mark += " ◆已派生重叠"
            name = sanitize(c["resolved_name"])
            title = sanitize(c["source_anchor"]["heading_path"][-1])
            # 候选名与标题末级相同就不重复挂一层
            if name != title:
                lines.append("  " * (indent + 1) + name + mark)
            elif mark:
                lines[-1] += mark


def export(json_path: Path) -> Path:
    data = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    board = data["board"]
    tree = build_tree(data["candidates"])
    lines = []
    root = sanitize(board)
    body = []
    render(tree, 1, body)
    # mindmap 只允许单根；若树顶层已是单一课程标题则直接作根
    top_keys = [k for k in tree if k != "__cands__"]
    if len(top_keys) == 1:
        lines.append(f"  root(({sanitize(top_keys[0])}))")
        sub = []
        render(tree[top_keys[0]], 2, sub)
        lines += sub
    else:
        lines.append(f"  root(({root}))")
        lines += body
    out = json_path.parent / f"思维导图-{board}.md"
    n = len(data["candidates"])
    md = (
        f"# 思维导图 · {board}\n\n"
        f"> 由 `board-split/scripts/export_mindmap.py` 只读生成，"
        f"来源 `{json_path.name}`（候选 {n} 个）。未修改任何 vault 文件。\n"
        f"> ⚠重名 = 与现有节点池重名；◆已派生重叠 = 该小节已有派生节点。\n\n"
        "```mermaid\nmindmap\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n```\n"
    )
    out.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        print(export(Path(p)))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""从 split-preview JSON 导出思维导图（Mermaid mindmap，Obsidian 原生渲染）。

只读消费 outputs/split-preview-<board>.json，唯一写入 = outputs/思维导图-<board>.md。
不触碰 原白板/、节点/、检验白板/。
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def sanitize(label: str) -> str:
    # Mermaid mindmap 节点文本不能含引起解析歧义的括号/引号，统一收敛
    label = re.sub(r"[()\[\]{}\"`]", " ", label)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", label).strip()


def build_tree(candidates):
    tree = {}
    for c in candidates:
        path = c["source_anchor"]["heading_path"]
        node = tree
        for part in path:
            node = node.setdefault(part, {})
        node.setdefault("__cands__", []).append(c)
    return tree


def render(node: dict, indent: int, lines: list):
    for key, child in node.items():
        if key == "__cands__":
            continue
        lines.append("  " * indent + sanitize(key))
        render(child, indent + 1, lines)
        for c in child.get("__cands__", []):
            mark = ""
            if c.get("name_conflict"):
                mark += " ⚠重名"
            if c.get("derived_overlap", {}).get("overlapping"):
                mark += " ◆已派生重叠"
            name = sanitize(c["resolved_name"])
            title = sanitize(c["source_anchor"]["heading_path"][-1])
            # 候选名与标题末级相同就不重复挂一层
            if name != title:
                lines.append("  " * (indent + 1) + name + mark)
            elif mark:
                lines[-1] += mark


def export(json_path: Path) -> Path:
    data = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    board = data["board"]
    tree = build_tree(data["candidates"])
    lines = []
    root = sanitize(board)
    body = []
    render(tree, 1, body)
    # mindmap 只允许单根；若树顶层已是单一课程标题则直接作根
    top_keys = [k for k in tree if k != "__cands__"]
    if len(top_keys) == 1:
        lines.append(f"  root(({sanitize(top_keys[0])}))")
        sub = []
        render(tree[top_keys[0]], 2, sub)
        lines += sub
    else:
        lines.append(f"  root(({root}))")
        lines += body
    out = json_path.parent / f"思维导图-{board}.md"
    n = len(data["candidates"])
    md = (
        f"# 思维导图 · {board}\n\n"
        f"> 由 `board-split/scripts/export_mindmap.py` 只读生成，"
        f"来源 `{json_path.name}`（候选 {n} 个）。未修改任何 vault 文件。\n"
        f"> ⚠重名 = 与现有节点池重名；◆已派生重叠 = 该小节已有派生节点。\n\n"
        "```mermaid\nmindmap\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n```\n"
    )
    out.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        print(export(Path(p)))
